# unifi_network_dns_record (Resource)

A local DNS record, served from the v2 `/static-dns` surface.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) DNS name (the record key), e.g. `host.example.com`.
- `value` (String) Record target (IP address, hostname, or text depending on type).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the record is active.
- `port` (Number) Port (SRV records).
- `priority` (Number) Priority (MX/SRV records).
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds; `0` (or unset) uses the controller default.
- `type` (String) Record type: `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`, `SRV`, or `NS`.
- `weight` (Number) Weight (SRV records).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
